transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our weekly readiness huddle started. We have one maintenance bay and one training yard available for scheduled use this week, and Alpha, Bravo, and Delta are all competing for time in both. I need to hear from each of you on your current constraints and required commitments so I can publish the weekly schedule before close of business today. Motor pool, training, and signal reps -- please go ahead and report.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a maintenance commitment that hasn't made it onto the company schedule yet. This morning I confirmed that two Alpha section vehicles require brake inspections in the maintenance bay on Monday at 0800, and they must be cleared before Alpha's Thursday movement. The work order is in the motor pool log but hasn't been added to the company schedule yet, so we need to lock in that bay time for Monday morning.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a training commitment that also hasn't made it onto the printed calendar yet. I've confirmed that Delta section has a certification evaluation on Thursday at 0800, and they must have the training yard from Tuesday at 1300 through 1600 for their final vehicle-handling rehearsal. The evaluator's confirmation arrived after the current training calendar was printed, so we need to lock in that yard time for Tuesday afternoon.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a signal commitment that hasn't made it onto the company schedule yet. I received a higher-headquarters directive requiring the company to complete a radio interoperability check on Monday at 1500. This check must be completed before any Tuesday movement. The directive is awaiting entry into the signal annex and hasn't been placed on the company schedule yet, so we need to lock in that time for Monday afternoon.
transcript.speaker: A4
